agendaItems.title:
File No. CRA26-26570
CRA Board to consider, discuss, act upon, and provide direction to staff and counsel regarding the draft Stadium and Development Agreement, and related draft agreements, by and among the Tampa Bay Rays Company, LLC, Hillsborough County, Florida, the City of Tampa, Florida, and the CRA, including any participation, funding, pledge of tax increment revenues, or other undertaking by the CRA contemplated thereby. (Original motion initiated by Clendenin-Viera on August 20, 2026)
